# Nuxt UI (Reka UI + Tailwind) + Kineto (v0.11.0)

붙이는 방식: **attrs-fallthrough** — Vue attribute fallthrough puts `data-kt-*` on the component's root element. Register a client plugin (`plugins/kineto.client.ts`) that imports the stylesheet and calls `Kineto.observe()`; use `v-motion` / `useKineto` from `@dong-gri/kineto/vue` when you need the instance.

```vue
<UCard data-kt-reveal="fade-up" data-kt-once>…</UCard>
<h1 data-kt-text-reveal="stream" class="text-5xl font-semibold">Nuxt launch</h1>
```

## 설치

```bash
npm install @dong-gri/kineto
```

```ts
// plugins/kineto.client.ts
import Kineto from '@dong-gri/kineto';
import '@dong-gri/kineto/style.css';

export default defineNuxtPlugin(() => {
  const handle = Kineto.observe();
  if (import.meta.hot) import.meta.hot.dispose(() => handle.disconnect());
});
```

## 이 라이브러리가 이미 제공하는 것

`accordion`, `tabs`, `tooltip`, `toast`, `modal`, `slideover`, `skeleton`, `progress`, `switch`, `carousel`, `navigation-menu` — 동작·접근성은 라이브러리에 맡기고 Kineto는 모션만 더합니다.

## 같이 쓰면 안 되는 조합

- Nuxt UI `UCarousel` (Embla) and `data-kt-slider`: choose one per container.
- Reka UI content nodes animate through `data-state`; add Kineto to their children.

## 참고

- Components rendered on the server keep the attributes, so hydration sees the same markup the observer will scan.

## 의도별 레시피

### 히어로 헤드라인 등장 (`hero-headline`)

- `textReveal` · `stream` — Characters resolve left to right — the default look for launch pages.

  ```vue
  <h1 data-kt-text-reveal="stream" data-kt-speed="30">Text</h1>
  <!-- or: <h1 v-motion="{ type: 'textReveal', options: { speed: 30, preset: "stream" } }"> -->
  ```

- `textReveal` · `hangul` — Korean copy: assembles jamo into syllables instead of flashing random glyphs.

  ```vue
  <h1 data-kt-text-reveal="hangul">Text</h1>
  <!-- or: <h1 v-motion="{ type: 'textReveal', options: { preset: "hangul" } }"> -->
  ```

- `textSplit` · `word` — Word-by-word rise for editorial headlines.

  ```vue
  <h2 data-kt-text-split="word" data-kt-stagger="0.06">Text</h2>
  <!-- or: <h2 v-motion="{ type: 'textSplit', options: { stagger: 0.06, preset: "word" } }"> -->
  ```

- `glitch` · `rgb` — Game/tech key art: RGB slice burst on the title.

  ```vue
  <h2 data-kt-glitch="rgb" data-kt-duration="1.2">Text</h2>
  <!-- or: <h2 v-motion="{ type: 'glitch', options: { duration: 1.2, preset: "rgb" } }"> -->
  ```

- `blurText` · `blur` — Blurred lines sharpen into place — soft, editorial headlines.

  ```vue
  <p data-kt-blur-text>Text</p>
  <!-- or: <p v-motion="{ type: 'blurText', options: { preset: "blur" } }"> -->
  ```

### 스크롤 진입 시 섹션·카드 등장 (`section-entrance`)

- `reveal` · `fade-up` — Default entrance for sections and cards.

  ```vue
  <section data-kt-reveal="fade-up" data-kt-once data-kt-duration="0.7">…</section>
  <!-- or: <section v-motion="{ type: 'reveal', options: { once: true, duration: 0.7, preset: "fade-up" } }"> -->
  ```

- `reveal` · `mask` — Editorial mask wipe for images and quotes.

  ```vue
  <section data-kt-reveal="mask" data-kt-direction="up">…</section>
  <!-- or: <section v-motion="{ type: 'reveal', options: { direction: "up", preset: "mask" } }"> -->
  ```

- `reveal` · `class` — Designer-owned CSS: Kineto only toggles the class, the stylesheet animates.

  ```vue
  <section data-kt-reveal="class">…</section>
  <!-- or: <section v-motion="{ type: 'reveal', options: { preset: "class" } }"> -->
  ```

- `coverReveal` · `block` — Colour block wipes across an image or heading.

  ```vue
  <div data-kt-cover-reveal data-kt-direction="left">…</div>
  <!-- or: <div v-motion="{ type: 'coverReveal', options: { direction: "left", preset: "block" } }"> -->
  ```

> For lists, add `data-kt-stagger` on the parent so children cascade instead of animating each item separately.

### 카드 호버 (틸트·글로우·스프링) (`card-hover`)

- `tilt` · `tilt-glare` — Pointer-following 3D tilt with a glare; showcase and product cards.

  ```vue
  <article data-kt-tilt="tilt-glare" data-kt-max="8">…</article>
  <!-- or: <article v-motion="{ type: 'tilt', options: { max: 8, preset: "tilt-glare" } }"> -->
  ```

- `cardGlow` · `spotlight` — Spotlight that follows the pointer inside the card (works on dark UIs).

  ```vue
  <article data-kt-card-glow="spotlight">…</article>
  <!-- or: <article v-motion="{ type: 'cardGlow', options: { preset: "spotlight" } }"> -->
  ```

- `cardGlow` · `border` — Luminous gradient border for pricing/feature cards.

  ```vue
  <article data-kt-card-glow="border">…</article>
  <!-- or: <article v-motion="{ type: 'cardGlow', options: { preset: "border" } }"> -->
  ```

- `gesture` · `spring` — Subtle spring lift for dense lists where 3D would be noisy.

  ```vue
  <button data-kt-gesture data-kt-hover-scale="1.02">Text</button>
  <!-- or: <button v-motion="{ type: 'gesture', options: { hoverScale: 1.02, preset: "spring" } }"> -->
  ```

> Pick one transform-writing module per element (tilt, gesture, magnetic all write transform).

- `ripple` · `material` — Click ripple for libraries without one (Bootstrap, daisyUI, Nuxt UI).

### 이미지 로딩 효과·플레이스홀더 (`image-loading`)

- `lazy` · `skeleton` — Shimmer placeholder that resolves into the image.

  ```vue
  <img data-kt-lazy="skeleton" data-kt-skeleton-variant="shimmer" data-src="/photo.webp" alt="">
  ```

- `lazy` · `blur-up` — Blurred preview sharpening — content sites.

  ```vue
  <img data-kt-lazy="blur-up" data-src="/photo.webp" alt="">
  ```

- `lazy` · `pixelate` — Stepped pixel mosaic settling into the image — editorial/product shots.

  ```vue
  <img data-kt-lazy="pixelate" data-src="/photo.webp" alt="">
  ```

> Library skeletons are layout boxes for text; Kineto's lazy skeleton sits on the `<img>` and hands off to the real picture with no layout shift.

### 이미지·영상 그래픽 질감 (`media-texture`)

- `stylize` · `dither` — Retro two-tone dither kept on the image (brand/showcase).

  ```vue
  <div data-kt-stylize="dither" data-kt-cell-size="8" data-kt-dither-type="4x4">…</div>
  <!-- or: <div v-motion="{ type: 'stylize', options: { cellSize: 8, ditherType: "4x4", preset: "dither" } }"> -->
  ```

- `stylize` · `dither` — Dither that shrinks into the original photo once it scrolls into view.

  ```vue
  <div data-kt-stylize="dither" data-kt-mode="reveal" data-kt-trigger="view" data-kt-cell-size="10">…</div>
  <!-- or: <div v-motion="{ type: 'stylize', options: { mode: "reveal", trigger: "view", cellSize: 10, preset: "dither" } }"> -->
  ```

- `stylize` · `dither` — The dither to reach for on a photograph: `noise` has no repeating tile, so a fine cell reads as texture instead of as an 8x8 weave. Use this before reaching for a smaller cell size.

  ```vue
  <div data-kt-stylize="dither" data-kt-dither-type="noise" data-kt-cell-size="3" data-kt-contrast="1.4">…</div>
  <!-- or: <div v-motion="{ type: 'stylize', options: { ditherType: "noise", cellSize: 3, contrast: 1.4, preset: "dither" } }"> -->
  ```

- `stylize` · `dither` — Clustered-dot print screen: ink grows as one blob per cell, the way newsprint and risograph do. Keep the cell small (1-3px) or the blobs read as a checkerboard.

  ```vue
  <div data-kt-stylize="dither" data-kt-dither-type="cluster" data-kt-cell-size="2" data-kt-contrast="1.5">…</div>
  <!-- or: <div v-motion="{ type: 'stylize', options: { ditherType: "cluster", cellSize: 2, contrast: 1.5, preset: "dither" } }"> -->
  ```

- `stylize` · `halftone` — Newspaper halftone. The angle is the part that matters: a screen square to the frame reads as a table, and tilting it 15-45 degrees is what makes it read as print.

  ```vue
  <div data-kt-stylize="halftone" data-kt-halftone-shape="dot" data-kt-halftone-angle="45" data-kt-cell-size="6" data-kt-contrast="1.35">…</div>
  <!-- or: <div v-motion="{ type: 'stylize', options: { halftoneShape: "dot", halftoneAngle: 45, cellSize: 6, contrast: 1.35, preset: "halftone" } }"> -->
  ```

- `stylize` · `halftone` — Open-ring screen: thin outlines in the highlights that close up in the shadows. A graphic, editorial texture rather than a photographic one.

  ```vue
  <div data-kt-stylize="halftone" data-kt-halftone-shape="ring" data-kt-halftone-angle="30" data-kt-cell-size="8">…</div>
  <!-- or: <div v-motion="{ type: 'stylize', options: { halftoneShape: "ring", halftoneAngle: 30, cellSize: 8, preset: "halftone" } }"> -->
  ```

- `stylize` · `dither` — A dither that stays on the image while the grain crawls — alive without moving the layout.

  ```vue
  <div data-kt-stylize="dither" data-kt-contrast="1.4" data-kt-cell-size="3" data-kt-motion="drift">…</div>
  <!-- or: <div v-motion="{ type: 'stylize', options: { contrast: 1.4, cellSize: 3, motion: "drift", preset: "dither" } }"> -->
  ```

- `stylize` · `ascii` — ASCII that keeps re-typing itself: the living-terminal look for a hero or an about page.

  ```vue
  <div data-kt-stylize="ascii" data-kt-motion="shuffle" data-kt-motion-amount="0.35">…</div>
  <!-- or: <div v-motion="{ type: 'stylize', options: { motion: "shuffle", motionAmount: 0.35, preset: "ascii" } }"> -->
  ```

- `stylize` · `dither` — The picture sharpens only under the pointer — an interaction, not just a filter.

  ```vue
  <div data-kt-stylize="dither" data-kt-cell-size="8" data-kt-pointer="lens" data-kt-pointer-cell-size="2">…</div>
  <!-- or: <div v-motion="{ type: 'stylize', options: { cellSize: 8, pointer: "lens", pointerCellSize: 2, preset: "dither" } }"> -->
  ```

- `stylize` · `halftone` — Permanent halftone print look on an image or video.

  ```vue
  <div data-kt-stylize="halftone">…</div>
  <!-- or: <div v-motion="{ type: 'stylize', options: { preset: "halftone" } }"> -->
  ```

- `stylize` · `ascii` — ASCII-art filter for terminal/tech aesthetics.

  ```vue
  <div data-kt-stylize="ascii">…</div>
  <!-- or: <div v-motion="{ type: 'stylize', options: { preset: "ascii" } }"> -->
  ```

- `glitch` · `image` — Chromatic-aberration glitch bursts over a photo — louder than a texture.

  ```vue
  <h2 data-kt-glitch="image">Text</h2>
  <!-- or: <h2 v-motion="{ type: 'glitch', options: { preset: "image" } }"> -->
  ```

> Raise `contrast` (1.3-1.6) before anything else: a photograph sits in the middle of the tonal range and dithers to grey mush at the default 1.

> Pick `ditherType` by the subject, not by taste: `noise` for a photograph (no repeating tile, so a fine cell reads as texture), `cluster` or a rotated `halftone` for a print look, `8x8`/`16x16` for a graphic two-tone treatment, and `floyd-steinberg`/`atkinson` when the original colours have to survive.

> Stylize redraws the pixels; it does not load anything. Pair it with the `image-loading` intent when the picture also needs lazy loading — both attributes can sit on one <img>.

> A source the canvas cannot read back (cross-origin without CORS) simply shows unstyled, so the texture is never a hard dependency.

> `motion` (drift/shuffle/scan/flow/pulse) keeps the look alive on a still picture and `pointer` (lens/spotlight/ripple) makes it react; both redraw every frame, so lower `renderFps` when several are on one screen.

### 캐러셀·슬라이더 (`carousel`)

이 라이브러리의 **UCarousel**를 먼저 씁니다. Kineto 레시피는 그 컴포넌트를 쓰지 않는 페이지에서만 적용합니다.

- `slider` · `slide` — Default content slider with drag, keyboard and dots.

  ```vue
  <div data-kt-slider="slide" data-kt-loop data-kt-autoplay="4000">…</div>
  <!-- or: <div v-motion="{ type: 'slider', options: { loop: true, autoplay: 4000, preset: "slide" } }"> -->
  ```

- `slider` · `coverflow` — 3D coverflow for showcases and app screenshots.

  ```vue
  <div data-kt-slider="coverflow">…</div>
  <!-- or: <div v-motion="{ type: 'slider', options: { preset: "coverflow" } }"> -->
  ```

- `slider` · `cards` — Stacked cards for testimonials.

  ```vue
  <div data-kt-slider="cards">…</div>
  <!-- or: <div v-motion="{ type: 'slider', options: { preset: "cards" } }"> -->
  ```

- `radial` · `bottom` — Circular carousel for hero character/product pickers.

  ```vue
  <div data-kt-radial="bottom">…</div>
  <!-- or: <div v-motion="{ type: 'radial', options: { preset: "bottom" } }"> -->
  ```

> Use the library carousel for plain content slides; switch to Kineto slider when the design asks for coverflow, cube, cards, flip or radial motion.

### 토스트 알림 (`toast`)

이 라이브러리의 **useToast**를 먼저 씁니다. Kineto 레시피는 그 컴포넌트를 쓰지 않는 페이지에서만 적용합니다.

- `toast` · `stack` — Stacked corner toasts with progress bar.

  ```vue
  <div data-kt-toast data-kt-position="bottom-right" data-kt-duration="4000">…</div>
  ```

### 툴팁 (`tooltip`)

이 라이브러리의 **UTooltip**를 먼저 씁니다. Kineto 레시피는 그 컴포넌트를 쓰지 않는 페이지에서만 적용합니다.

- `tooltip` · `default` — Pointer/focus/click tooltip with placement.

  ```vue
  <button data-kt-tooltip data-kt-placement="top">Text</button>
  <!-- or: <button v-motion="{ type: 'tooltip', options: { placement: "top", effect: "default" } }"> -->
  ```

### 다이얼로그·모달 등장/퇴장 모션 (`dialog-enter-exit`)

**UModal**가 열림·닫힘과 포커스를 소유합니다. Kineto는 그 안의 콘텐츠에만 모션을 더합니다.

- `presence` — Host-owned enter/leave: `<KinetoPresence>` (React) or `useKinetoTransition` (Vue) around the dialog body.

  ```vue
  import { Transition } from 'vue';
  import { useKinetoTransition } from '@dong-gri/kineto/vue';
  const transition = useKinetoTransition('reveal', { enterOptions: { preset: 'fade-up', duration: 0.35 }, leaveOptions: { preset: 'fade', duration: 0.2 } });
  <Transition v-bind="transition"><div v-if="open">…</div></Transition>
  ```

- `reveal` · `zoom-in` — One-shot entrance for the modal body when the library only fades the overlay.

  ```vue
  <section data-kt-reveal="zoom-in" data-kt-duration="0.35">…</section>
  <!-- or: <section v-motion="{ type: 'reveal', options: { duration: 0.35, preset: "zoom-in" } }"> -->
  ```

- `pageReveal` · `iris` — Full-screen takeover transitions (showcase/event sites).

  ```vue
  <body data-kt-page-reveal="iris">…</body>
  <!-- or: <body v-motion="{ type: 'pageReveal', options: { preset: "iris" } }"> -->
  ```

> The library owns open/close and focus; Kineto animates the content inside.

### 모바일 바텀시트 (`bottom-sheet`)

이 라이브러리의 **USlideover**를 먼저 씁니다. Kineto 레시피는 그 컴포넌트를 쓰지 않는 페이지에서만 적용합니다.

- `bottomSheet` · `sheet` — Draggable, resizable mobile sheet with backdrop.

  ```vue
  <div data-kt-bottom-sheet data-kt-resizable data-kt-handle>…</div>
  <!-- or: <div v-motion="{ type: 'bottomSheet', options: { resizable: true, handle: true, preset: "sheet" } }"> -->
  ```

### 페이지 전환·첫 진입 리빌 (`page-transition`)

- `pageReveal` · `curtain` — First-paint curtain that opens once the page is ready.

  ```vue
  <body data-kt-page-reveal="curtain" data-kt-color="#0a0908">…</body>
  <!-- or: <body v-motion="{ type: 'pageReveal', options: { color: "#0a0908", preset: "curtain" } }"> -->
  ```

- `pageTransition` · `same-origin` — Multi-page sites: fetch same-origin pages and animate between them.

  ```vue
  <body data-kt-page-transition data-kt-container="main">…</body>
  <!-- or: <body v-motion="{ type: 'pageTransition', options: { container: "main", effect: "same-origin" } }"> -->
  ```

- `loader` · `bar` — Full-screen loader bound to real load progress.

  ```vue
  <div data-kt-loader="bar" data-kt-source="window">…</div>
  <!-- or: <div v-motion="{ type: 'loader', options: { source: "window", preset: "bar" } }"> -->
  ```

> SPA routers (Next.js, Nuxt, React Router) own navigation — use `pageReveal` on first paint and presence for route content, never `pageTransition`.

  ```vue
  <div data-kt-progress="element:width" data-kt-ui="ring" data-kt-click-to-top>…</div>
  <!-- or: <div v-motion="{ type: 'progress', options: { ui: "ring", clickToTop: true, preset: "element:width" } }"> -->
  ```

### 스크롤에 반응하는 고정 헤더 (`sticky-header`)

- `stickyHeader` · `shrink` — Compact header after the first scroll.

  ```vue
  <header data-kt-sticky-header="shrink" data-kt-distance="80">…</header>
  <!-- or: <header v-motion="{ type: 'stickyHeader', options: { distance: 80, preset: "shrink" } }"> -->
  ```

- `stickyHeader` · `toggle` — Hide on scroll down, show on scroll up.

  ```vue
  <header data-kt-sticky-header="toggle">…</header>
  <!-- or: <header v-motion="{ type: 'stickyHeader', options: { preset: "toggle" } }"> -->
  ```

- `megaMenu` · `dropdown` — GNB dropdown / mega panel for sites without a navigation component.

  ```vue
  <nav data-kt-mega-menu="dropdown">…</nav>
  <!-- or: <nav v-motion="{ type: 'megaMenu', options: { preset: "dropdown" } }"> -->
  ```

### 패럴랙스·포인터 깊이감 (`parallax-depth`)

- `parallax` · `y` — Scroll parallax per layer.

  ```vue
  <div data-kt-parallax="y" data-kt-speed="0.3">…</div>
  <!-- or: <div v-motion="{ type: 'parallax', options: { speed: 0.3, preset: "y" } }"> -->
  ```

- `mouseParallax` · `pointer` — Layers follow the pointer (gyro on mobile).

  ```vue
  <div data-kt-mouse-parallax="pointer" data-kt-sensitivity="1">…</div>
  <!-- or: <div v-motion="{ type: 'mouseParallax', options: { sensitivity: 1, preset: "pointer" } }"> -->
  ```

- `ambientMedia` · `image-clone` — Ambient glow sampled from the media behind it.

  ```vue
  <img data-kt-ambient-media="image-clone" data-src="/photo.webp" alt="">
  ```

### 스크롤 스토리텔링 (`scroll-storytelling`)

- `scrollSequence` · `cover` — Scrub an image sequence with scroll (product reveals).

  ```vue
  <div data-kt-scroll-sequence="cover" data-kt-frames="120">…</div>
  <!-- or: <div v-motion="{ type: 'scrollSequence', options: { frames: 120, preset: "cover" } }"> -->
  ```

- `stickyStack` · `vertical` — Cards pin and stack while scrolling.

  ```vue
  <section data-kt-sticky-stack="vertical">…</section>
  <!-- or: <section v-motion="{ type: 'stickyStack', options: { preset: "vertical" } }"> -->
  ```

- `horizontalScroll` · `pin` — Vertical scroll drives a horizontal track.

  ```vue
  <section data-kt-horizontal-scroll>…</section>
  <!-- or: <section v-motion="{ type: 'horizontalScroll', options: { preset: "pin" } }"> -->
  ```

- `textFill` · `scroll-fill` — Copy fills with colour as it scrolls into view.

  ```vue
  <p data-kt-text-fill>Text</p>
  <!-- or: <p v-motion="{ type: 'textFill', options: { preset: "scroll-fill" } }"> -->
  ```

- `cssScroll` · `progress-property` — Expose scroll progress as a CSS custom property for your own animations.

  ```vue
  <div data-kt-css-scroll="progress-property">…</div>
  <!-- or: <div v-motion="{ type: 'cssScroll', options: { preset: "progress-property" } }"> -->
  ```

- `scrollVelocity` · `skew` — Elements skew, rotate or scale with scroll velocity for kinetic type.

  ```vue
  <div data-kt-scroll-velocity="skew">…</div>
  <!-- or: <div v-motion="{ type: 'scrollVelocity', options: { preset: "skew" } }"> -->
  ```

### 인라인 로딩 인디케이터·실제 진행률 (`loading-state`)

이 라이브러리의 **UProgress**를 먼저 씁니다. Kineto 레시피는 그 컴포넌트를 쓰지 않는 페이지에서만 적용합니다.

- `loadingIndicator` · `spinner` — Inline spinner (with the library's spinner absent or when a determinate source exists).

  ```vue
  <span data-kt-loading-indicator="spinner">Text</span>
  <!-- or: <span v-motion="{ type: 'loadingIndicator', options: { preset: "spinner" } }"> -->
  ```

- `loadingIndicator` · `terminal` — Terminal-style frames for developer/AI products.

  ```vue
  <span data-kt-loading-indicator="terminal">Text</span>
  <!-- or: <span v-motion="{ type: 'loadingIndicator', options: { preset: "terminal" } }"> -->
  ```

- `loader` · `circular` — Full-screen loader bound to fetch/promise/resource progress.

  ```vue
  <div data-kt-loader="circular" data-kt-source="fetch">…</div>
  <!-- or: <div v-motion="{ type: 'loader', options: { source: "fetch", preset: "circular" } }"> -->
  ```

> Use the library spinner for indeterminate waits; use Kineto `loader` when you can bind a real progress source (`trackPromise`, `trackFetch`, resources).

### 단어 교체·타이프라이터 (`text-rotation`)

- `textTransition` · `slide-up` — Cycles words in a headline.

  ```vue
  <h2 data-kt-text-transition="slide-up" data-kt-texts="[&quot;design&quot;,&quot;motion&quot;,&quot;ship&quot;]" data-kt-hold="1.4">Text</h2>
  <!-- or: <h2 v-motion="{ type: 'textTransition', options: { texts: ["design","motion","ship"], hold: 1.4, preset: "slide-up" } }"> -->
  ```

- `typewriter` · `type-erase` — Types and erases strings, composing Korean jamo.

  ```vue
  <p data-kt-typewriter data-kt-strings="[&quot;Hello&quot;,&quot;안녕하세요&quot;]" data-kt-hangul>Text</p>
  <!-- or: <p v-motion="{ type: 'typewriter', options: { strings: ["Hello","안녕하세요"], hangul: true, preset: "type-erase" } }"> -->
  ```

### 글리치·CRT 악센트 (`glitch-accent`)

- `glitch` · `rgb` — RGB slice bursts on text (game titles, event banners).

  ```vue
  <h2 data-kt-glitch="rgb">Text</h2>
  <!-- or: <h2 v-motion="{ type: 'glitch', options: { preset: "rgb" } }"> -->
  ```

- `glitch` · `crt` — CRT scan and roll on images.

  ```vue
  <h2 data-kt-glitch="crt">Text</h2>
  <!-- or: <h2 v-motion="{ type: 'glitch', options: { preset: "crt" } }"> -->
  ```

- `glitch` · `vcr` — VHS tracking band on key art.

  ```vue
  <h2 data-kt-glitch="vcr">Text</h2>
  <!-- or: <h2 v-motion="{ type: 'glitch', options: { preset: "vcr" } }"> -->
  ```

- `lazy` · `crt` — CRT power-on reveal while an image loads.

  ```vue
  <img data-kt-lazy="crt" data-src="/photo.webp" alt="">
  ```

### 커스텀 커서 (`custom-cursor`)

- `cursor` · `ring` — Dot + eased ring for showcase and portfolio sites.

  ```vue
  <body data-kt-cursor="ring">…</body>
  <!-- or: <body v-motion="{ type: 'cursor', options: { preset: "ring" } }"> -->
  ```

- `cursor` · `text` — Rotating text ring over hoverable media.

  ```vue
  <body data-kt-cursor="text" data-kt-rotate-text="VIEW · VIEW · ">…</body>
  <!-- or: <body v-motion="{ type: 'cursor', options: { rotateText: "VIEW · VIEW · ", preset: "text" } }"> -->
  ```

- `cursor` · `image` — Image or sprite cursor (must be same-origin for demos).

  ```vue
  <body data-kt-cursor="image" data-kt-src="./cursor.webp">…</body>
  <!-- or: <body v-motion="{ type: 'cursor', options: { src: "./cursor.webp", preset: "image" } }"> -->
  ```

> Desktop pointer only; Kineto keeps the native cursor on touch devices.

### 성공 축하 효과 (`celebration`)

- `confetti` · `burst` — Confetti burst on a button or when a section enters view.

  ```vue
  <button data-kt-confetti data-kt-trigger="click">Text</button>
  <!-- or: <button v-motion="{ type: 'confetti', options: { trigger: "click", preset: "burst" } }"> -->
  ```

- `vibrate` · `success` — Success haptic on supported devices.

  ```vue
  <button data-kt-vibrate="success">Text</button>
  <!-- or: <button v-motion="{ type: 'vibrate', options: { preset: "success" } }"> -->
  ```

### 스크롤 영역 가장자리 그림자 (`overflow-shadows`)

- `scrollShadows` · `horizontal` — Edge shadows on horizontally scrolling chip rows.

  ```vue
  <div data-kt-scroll-shadows="horizontal">…</div>
  <!-- or: <div v-motion="{ type: 'scrollShadows', options: { mode: "horizontal" } }"> -->
  ```

- `scrollShadows` · `mask` — Fade masks for vertical lists.

  ```vue
  <!-- or: <div v-motion="{ type: 'scrollShadows', options: { mode: "mask" } }"> -->
  ```

### iOS 스타일 모서리(스퀘어클) (`corner-shape`)

- `squircle` · `squircle` — Figma's corner smoothing and iOS icons are superellipses, not circles. `border-radius` alone cannot draw one, and CSS `corner-shape` is Chromium-only — this uses it there and draws the same curve everywhere else.

  ```vue
  <div data-kt-squircle="squircle">…</div>
  <!-- or: <div v-motion="{ type: 'squircle', options: { preset: "squircle" } }"> -->
  ```

- `squircle` · `bevel` — A straight diagonal cut, for ticket stubs, tags and cut-corner panels.

  ```vue
  <div data-kt-squircle="bevel">…</div>
  <!-- or: <div v-motion="{ type: 'squircle', options: { preset: "bevel" } }"> -->
  ```

- `squircle` · `notch` — A square bite out of each corner, for coupon and stamp shapes.

  ```vue
  <div data-kt-squircle="notch">…</div>
  <!-- or: <div v-motion="{ type: 'squircle', options: { preset: "notch" } }"> -->
  ```

### 길게 눌러 확인 (`confirm-hold`)

- `hold` · `confirm` — Destructive actions confirmed by holding the button.

  ```vue

  <!-- or: <button v-motion="{ type: 'hold', options: { duration: 1.2, mode: "confirm" } }"> -->
  ```

### 아코디언·탭·스위치·메가메뉴 (`disclosure`)

이 라이브러리의 **UAccordion / UTabs / USwitch**를 먼저 씁니다. Kineto 레시피는 그 컴포넌트를 쓰지 않는 페이지에서만 적용합니다.

- `accordion` · `panel` — `<details>`-based accordion with animated height.

  ```vue
  <div data-kt-accordion data-kt-single>…</div>
  <!-- or: <div v-motion="{ type: 'accordion', options: { single: true, effect: "panel" } }"> -->
  ```

- `tabs` · `line` — WAI-ARIA tabs with a sliding indicator.

  ```vue
  <div data-kt-tabs>…</div>
  <!-- or: <div v-motion="{ type: 'tabs', options: { effect: "line" } }"> -->
  ```

- `switch` · `toggle` — Form-connected toggle switch.

  ```vue
  <button data-kt-switch>Text</button>
  <!-- or: <button v-motion="{ type: 'switch', options: { preset: "toggle" } }"> -->
  ```

- `megaMenu` · `mega` — Mega menu with touch/mobile handling.

  ```vue
  <nav data-kt-mega-menu="mega">…</nav>
  <!-- or: <nav v-motion="{ type: 'megaMenu', options: { preset: "mega" } }"> -->
  ```

> Use the library's component for behaviour and accessibility; use Kineto's only in vanilla/Bootstrap-less pages.

### 재정렬·추가·삭제 애니메이션 (FLIP) (`layout-change`)

- `flip` · `layout` — Animates items between layout states when the DOM changes.

  ```vue
  <ul data-kt-flip="layout" data-kt-watch><li>…</li></ul>
  <!-- or: <ul v-motion="{ type: 'flip', options: { watch: true, mode: "layout" } }"> -->
  ```

- `flip` · `crossfade` — Items that swap content crossfade in place.

  ```vue
  <ul data-kt-flip="crossfade"><li>…</li></ul>
  <!-- or: <ul v-motion="{ type: 'flip', options: { mode: "crossfade" } }"> -->
  ```

- `drag` · `free` — Inertia drag with bounds and keyboard arrows.

  ```vue
  <div data-kt-drag data-kt-inertia data-kt-snap-back>…</div>
  ```
